jobs.occupation: Associate, GOglobal Graduate Program Inhouse Consulting (Trainee Program) (all genders) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

The GOglobal Graduate Program (GGP) is the company’s career accelerator for high potential graduates who are early in their careers. During the 24-month talent development program, you will gain experience through a combination of strategic management consulting projects and functional rotations tailored to your interests and development goals. These rotations may take place across Healthcare, Life Science, Electronics, and Group Functions.

In the first year, you will be working in the Inhouse Consulting team, where you will have the opportunity to tackle challenging problems under the guidance of experienced consultants and to acquire extensive management and problem-solving skills. Inhouse Consulting projects focus primarily on strategy, growth, as well as operational optimization, and our internal clients are typically senior-level executives within the company. The first year will help you to gain a good knowledge of the company and maximize your exposure to different subjects and stakeholders. You will also participate in targeted professional trainings as well as our coaching & mentoring program to continuously improve your technical expertise and business acumen.

In the second year, you will be working on several individual assignments within our sectors: Healthcare, Life Science, Electronics and Group Functions. Depending on our business needs and your preference, you’ll get the chance to expand your network and gain in-depth knowledge in the day-to-day operations of different functions, such as marketing, R&D, production, and strategic management. Each assignment will last three to four months, with one international assignment.

Overall, the program allows you to gain the skills and knowledge needed to become an early thought leader in an area, as well as the ability to independently manage complex projects and diverse stakeholders within a matrix organization.

After successful completion, you will move into an exciting role within one of our businesses depending upon your interest and career aspirations, professional development opportunities, and business needs from which you will continue your development as a future leader within the organization.

Next start date: March 2027, limited contract for two years; Position is based in Darmstadt, Germany with no support for relocation from outside Europe possible.

Several positions available

Who you are:

- Ideal candidates for the GOglobal Graduate Program are early in their careers (maximum 2 years of full ‑ time work experience), enjoy working in teams, and have a global mindset.
- MBA, Master’s degree, or PhD in natural sciences, engineering, or business.
- Candidates with an advanced degree in science or engineering must have demonstrated a strong interest in business through professional experience or internships in consulting or strategy in i ndustry ‑ related fields (e.g., pharma, biotech, diagnostics, bioprocessing, biology, chemistry, semiconductor solutions).
- Candidates with a business background must have demonstrated interest through professional experience, or internships in industry ‑ related fields (e.g., pharma, biotech, diagnostics, bioprocessing, biology, chemistry, semiconductor solutions) through relevant professional experience or internships.
- Practical experience applying Data & AI to solve business challenges in  industry ‑ related fields, combined with a passion for further developing skills in this area, is a plus.
- Strong analytical skills, excitement for complex and ambiguous work, curiosity for our diverse business sectors and a broad range of topics.
- Outstanding communication and team-work skills.
- Proactive and self-motivated mindset.
- Outstanding academic achievements.
- Profound knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint).
- Excellent verbal and written English (German is a plus).

Recruiting Timeline:

CV Submission: By September 13, 2026 at the latest
Virtual Case Interview: Completed by the beginning of October 2026
Assessment Days on-site in Darmstadt:

- Option 1: Monday, October 12, 2026
- Option 2: Thursday, October 15, 2026
- Option 3: Monday, October 19, 2026

We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Automation Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
What to expect
• You own our native mobile end-to-end test automation stack (Maestro, iOS and Android), taking ownership of architecture, conventions, and suite health. You keep the suite small, deterministic, and cross-platform, because a reliable smoke and regression suite beats a large, flaky one.
• You design and operate AI-driven test workflows where agents generate Maestro flows from specs and test cases (TestRail, Confluence), self-heal selectors, and triage failures. You review and harden everything the agents produce.
• You drive testability into the product and build deterministic test foundations through stubbing, fixtures, and contract tests.
• You own our CI quality gates (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and define where the test-pyramid boundary sits.
• You review and elevate the work of our developers and manual QA, coaching them on writing testable code and on reviewing AI-generated tests.
• You extend automation to our web stack (Playwright, Angular) where it adds value, always keeping the overall suite lean and reliable.

Your background
• You have 5+ years in test automation or SDET roles, with at least two of them owning test infrastructure (frameworks, CI, environments, test data), not just authoring suites.
• You have delivered native mobile end-to-end automation on real projects (Maestro, Appium, XCUITest, or Espresso) and can explain the flakiness trade-offs between them.
• You bring developer-level scripting and programming ability (Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, or Python) and read app code to add testability hooks yourself.
• You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) in a testing workflow, or credible evidence that you will adopt it fast. This is core to the role, not a nice-to-have.
• You have a clear stance on test-data determinism through stubbing, fixtures, and contract tests, and you have a proven track record of eliminating flakiness and keeping suites deterministic.
• You ideally bring experience in CI/CD pipeline ownership (including device farms and simulators), web E2E with Playwright, white-label or multi-tenant product experience, visual and snapshot regression testing, and TestRail integration and reporting.
• You communicate clearly in English and collaborate well with Product Owners and cross-functional teams.

What we offer
• The opportunity to develop freely in a growing company within a dynamic industry, shape the future, and continuously develop yourself.
• The chance to take on responsibility from day one and leverage our short and fast decision-making processes to make an impact.
• Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of vacation.
• The possibility to work remotely several days per week.
• An attractive, competitive salary and a variety of additional benefits (HVV ProfiCard, pension subsidy, etc.).

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Airbus Interior Noise department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student in the field of Acoustics - Interior Noise (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an Acoustics Engineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Interior Noise department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.01.2027
- Duration: 6 months

We are offering a Master Thesis opportunity focusing on acoustics, specifically interior noise. This role provides a unique chance to contribute to cutting-edge aerospace research and development within a leading global company.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Conducting in-depth research and analysis of interior noise sources and propagation within aircraft cabins.
- Developing and applying advanced simulation models and experimental methodologies for acoustic analysis.
- Evaluating and comparing different noise reduction strategies and materials.* Collecting and analyzing data from various sources, including laboratory tests and flight measurements.
- Documenting research findings and presenting results in a clear and concise manner.
- Collaborating with experienced engineers and researchers within the acoustics department.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, or a related field.
- Strong academic record with a focus on acoustics, vibrations, or signal processing.
- Proficiency in relevant software tools (e.g., MATLAB, ANSYS, COMSOL, LMS Test.Lab) is a plus.
- Experience with experimental acoustics and data acquisition systems is beneficial.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; German language skills are a plus.

jobs.description:

Job description

In order to support the Industrial Architecture Team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) for Industrial Architecture

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Industrial Architect?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in department designation as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

At Airbus, Industrial Architecture is driving the next evolution of flight. We are looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking student to join us in shaping the industrial system for our next-generation single-aisle aircraft. If you are passionate about innovation, teamwork, and making a real-world impact, we would love to welcome you to our team.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration:  12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

- Coordinate & Align: Help keep our international teams connected and on track by co-creating and managing progress updates across time, cost, and quality.
- Encourage Fresh Perspectives: Bring your unique curiosity to the table. We value open dialogue and encourage you to constructively question the "status quo" to help us discover creative, innovative paths forward.
- Foster Connection: Support the organization and execution of collaborative events that bring our management and transnational teams together.

The Team

You will join a diverse, supportive, and highly collaborative network of Airbus industrial architects across Germany, France, and Spain, alongside our external partners. We pride ourselves on a culture of mutual respect, learning, and cross-border cooperation.

One of the most operationally significant roles in the new CREM structure, the Global Head of Facilities Management is responsible for leading and transforming Merck's facilities and workplace management function across a global portfolio of 340+ locations and 4.3 million m² — encompassing offices, standalone labs, warehouses and selected soft services at manufacturing sites across more than 60 countries.
This is a dual-focus role requiring transformational vision and strict operational leadership. You will consolidate our existing FM foundation into a high-performing, data-informed ecosystem designed to minimise operational vulnerability. Through uniform service delivery standards and a consolidated regional IFM vendor model, you will drive process efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and unlock strategic business value across Merck's global footprint.
The scale of the people dimension alone is significant: this role leads a global FM organisation with a substantial team within CREM, with additional headcount transferring from business sectors as the expanded remit is stood up.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- FM Strategy & Vision: Define and own the global FM strategy for CREM — establishing a unified vision, service delivery model and operating standards across all asset classes and geographies, aligned to Merck's broader corporate objectives.
- Transformation Leadership: Lead the FM transformation programme — driving vendor consolidation toward a consolidated regional IFM model, standing up site-level governance, managing the lift-and-shift of FM services from business sectors, and embedding a performance management culture across the function.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with business sector leads, site managers and senior Merck stakeholders — positioning FM as a value-creating partner and ensuring the function is responsive to business needs.
- Operational Leadership: Ensure consistent, high-quality FM service delivery and drive operational excellence across the full portfolio by standardising service delivery and optimising facilities performance — maintaining service continuity throughout the transformation and holding Regional Heads accountable for operational performance within their geographies.
- IFM Partner Management: Own Merck's most senior relationships with global and regional IFM providers — acting as the primary Merck counterpart in strategic vendor negotiations, performance reviews and vendor [AB8.1]management at a global level.
- FM Budget Responsibility: Manage the global FM budget, allocating, monitoring, and optimising operational and capital expenditure (OpEx/CapEx) across the portfolio to ensure cost-efficiency, regulatory compliance, and alignment with corporate financial objectives.
- Budget Authority: Hold direct budget authority for FM vendor contracts and operational spend across the full scope — managing significant global FM expenditure, driving cost efficiency and ensuring financial transparency across the function.
- Standards & Compliance: Establish and enforce binding global FM standards — covering vendor protocols, preventative maintenance schedules, H&S compliance, SLAs and performance penalties. Ensure consistent application across all geographies.
- Manufacturing FM: Oversee the delivery of selected soft FM services at manufacturing sites — working in close collaboration with the Quality & Compliance Lead to ensure service delivery meets the specific operational and regulatory requirements of Merck's manufacturing environments.
- Performance Management: Establish and own the FM KPI framework — tracking performance against industry benchmarks (IFMA, RICS), driving continuous improvement and ensuring data-driven decision making is embedded across the function to achieve operational excellence.
- People Management: Lead, develop and inspire a global FM organisation — including four Regional Heads and the Quality & Compliance Lead — through a period of significant organisational change, building a high-performance culture.
